raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Remove an intermediate activation copy in large eager DeepSeek-V4.1 prefills by writing mHC output directly into MegaMoE's existing symmetric buffers.

Main's #46163 covers MegaGate decode/target-verify. This PR adds the large eager-prefill path, including routing metadata outside MegaGate, while reusing the shared Mega-mHC output interface.

## Modifications

- Write quantized activations and scales into validated, preallocated buffers without collective allocation.
- Preserve routing metadata handling and the existing fallback for small/idle batches, CUDA graph capture, and unsupported configurations.
- Enable the fast path for eager SM10x prefills with at least 16,384 rows.

Adapted from the producer/buffer boundary in [DeepInfer](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer/blob/9bd9cf243fc53ef9afbf8f04d391d989117d6ab9/deepinfer/model_executor/models/v4_modules/hc.py).

## Accuracy Tests

Merge validation: pre-commit and local mocked control-flow checks passed (4 producer combinations, 24 consumer cases). The GSM8K and earlier exact-output results below predate the merge.

The current-head DSv4.1 DP2/EP2 model CI is a regression check, not coverage of this optimization: it uses `--moe-a2a-backend none` and does not exercise the >=16,384-row MegaMoE branch. Current-head directed numerical validation passed on two GPU ranks using production producer/consumer code with random weights at model dimensions: 27 records per rank cover 33,792-row batches, unequal and idle ranks, the 16,384-row boundary, routing metadata ownership, descriptor-identity fallback, and actual CUDA graph fallback. Valid quantized activation/scales/routing buffers, mHC boundary outputs, and final MoE outputs matched exactly. Buffer poisoning checks were included. This establishes the tested numerical boundary behavior; it is not a full-checkpoint accuracy evaluation.

Current-head checkpoint-backed shadow validation also passed: 256 measured comparisons per rank at 33,792 rows, visiting source layers 0–19 with real checkpoint weights/activations. The tested mHC/MoE boundary outputs matched exactly. This exercised `routing_in_buffer=False`; the alternate routing-buffer path is covered by the directed tests above. This is boundary validation, not a current-head full quality benchmark.

Selected current-head `/rerun-test` runs passed: [MegaMoE API](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40067841992), [pre-dispatch](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40067849548), [mHC kernels](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40067856516), and [DSv4.1 DP2/EP2 regression](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40067863921). The model regression's backend limitation above still applies.

Earlier-head validation:

- Reported exact-output checks passed for uneven/idle batches, routing metadata paths, capacity padding, and CUDA graph fallback.
- GSM8K (1,314 examples): baseline **97.34%**, candidate **97.56%**. No accuracy improvement is claimed; most cached-suffix batches exercised the fallback.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Current candidate `9387694b2a1c060ffd7d405a783a77294f481c24` versus baseline `1335d372f0a58857422e40b89a097daa7d3bf86c`, using measured script revision `32457f3689d4d38b1ecf774a02bc4de047e51d9b`, based on #46006. The identical script file is now published in #46006 at `1aa97c3865fb6b7667f0b8e43f9e316fe79804e4` (SHA256 `c402a986dca6d9fdd59e4957eeaf53f37425fb78b39d9ef69c390d0661ec2dc3`). This version fixes suffix assignment per rank and can retain raw completions after requests drain; scoring is unchanged.

Matched ABBA, 4,096 requests per rank, 131,072 context tokens, 4,096 uncached suffix tokens, and 32,768 new tokens per rank per step. Both replay paths are enabled, producing 33,792 physical rows per rank. Resolved topology is TP2/EP2/attention-DP2/replica-DP1.

| Arm | Baseline (ms/step) | Candidate (ms/step) | Throughput change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| A1 → B1 | 333.772134 | 333.445486 | +0.09796% |
| B2 → A2 | 333.733122 | 333.375643 | +0.10723% |

The mean throughput improvement is **0.1026%**: repeatable within this matched comparison, but very small. Baseline span was 0.01169%, candidate span 0.02095%. All four arms passed the original benchmark guards, drained 8,192 requests, and reproduced their scores exactly from retained completions. Startup Engram huge-page counts matched across arms.

These are fixed-batch engine-step results. Agent/application E2E benefit has not been established. Earlier larger numbers used older code or the pre-fix input generator and are not substituted for this current-head result.

<details>
<summary>Measured configuration and reproduction command</summary>

Use the two source revisions above with the same model files and runtime. Recorded versions: PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, FlashInfer 0.7.2, sgl-deep-gemm 0.2.3.post2, sgl-flash-mla 1.0.0, deepseek-recipe 0.2.0. Use two GB300 GPUs. Configure a fresh Mooncake master per arm, RDMA transport, and `MOONCAKE_GLOBAL_SEGMENT_SIZE=150gb` per rank; supply deployment-specific Mooncake addresses and RDMA device externally. Local model/log/output paths are normalized below. The older `--data-parallel-size 2 --enable-dp-attention` flags resolve to attention-DP2 with one replica for these revisions.

```bash

export SGLANG_NUMA_BIND_V2=0
export SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_WAITING_TIMEOUT=900
export SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=65536
export SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=900
export SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=static
export SGLANG_DSV41_REASONING_EFFORT=high
export SGLANG_DEFAULT_THINKING=1
export SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected
export SGLANG_JIT_DEEPGEMM_PRECOMPILE=0
export SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=real-draft-token
export SGLANG_USE_CUDA_IPC_TRANSPORT=0
export SGLANG_ENABLE_TORCH_COMPILE=0
export SGLANG_ENABLE_DETERMINISTIC_INFERENCE=0

python benchmark/engine_steps/bench_engine_steps.py \
  prefill \
  --engine \
  --dp 2 \
  --num-gpus 2 \
  --context 131072 \
  --new-tokens 4096 \
  --tokens-per-step 32768 \
  --requests 4096 \
  --warmup-steps 5 \
  --timeout 900 \
  --seed 733427905 \
  --server-log server.log \
  --out result.json \
  --prefill-completions completions.json \
  --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --chunked-prefill-size 67584 \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 1 \
  --data-parallel-size 2 \
  --disable-decode-cuda-graph \
  --dsv4-attn-backend flashmla_mega \
  --enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay \
  --enable-dp-attention \
  --enable-dp-lm-head \
  --enable-metrics \
  --expert-parallel-size 2 \
  --max-running-requests 256 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.9 \
  --moe-a2a-backend megamoe \
  --random-seed 733427905 \
  --served-model-name deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --speculative-algorithm DSPARK \
  --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 \
  --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.12 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --watchdog-timeout 3600 \
  --skip-server-warmup \
  --enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay \
  --max-prefill-tokens 33792 \
  --enable-unified-cache-external-linker \
  --unified-cache-external-linker-backend mooncake \
  --hicache-storage-backend-extra-config '{"enable_group_semantics":true}' \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 30100 \
  --nccl-port 23515
```

</details>

## Checklist

- [x] Format with pre-commit.
- [x] Extend the existing API test for non-allocating producer lookup.
- [x] Current-head directed large-row producer/consumer numerical validation.
- [x] Complete current-head matched ABBA with rank-stable inputs and raw-score reproduction.
- [ ] Maintainer review of scope and supported configurations.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+"""Routing metadata for an already quantized MegaMoE activation buffer."""
+
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _copy_metadata(I, W, OI, OW, N: tl.constexpr, P: tl.constexpr, B: tl.constexpr):
+    off = tl.program_id(0) * B + tl.arange(0, B)
+    indices = tl.load(I + off, off < N, -1)
+    weights = tl.load(W + off, off < N, 0)
+    tl.store(OI + off, indices, off < P)
+    tl.store(OW + off, weights, off < P)
+
+
+def copy_mega_moe_metadata(indices, weights, out_indices, out_weights):
+    assert indices.shape == weights.shape
+    assert out_indices.shape == out_weights.shape
+    assert indices.shape[1] == out_indices.shape[1]
+    assert indices.shape[0] <= out_indices.shape[0]
+    assert all(t.is_contiguous() for t in (indices, weights, out_indices, out_weights))
+    _copy_metadata[(triton.cdiv(out_indices.numel(), 256),)](
+        indices,
+        weights,
+        out_indices,
+        out_weights,
+        indices.numel(),
+        out_indices.numel(),
+        256,
+    )

@@ -30,7 +30,11 @@
     is_sm90_fp8_mega_moe_available,
     run_sm90_mega_routed,
 )
-from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import get_moe_a2a_backend
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import (
+    get_moe_a2a_backend,
+    is_sbo_enabled,
+    is_tbo_enabled,
